A_player_profile.method: ridge YPC residual to incumbent, player prior carry profile only

B_defense_allowance.method: ridge YPC residual to incumbent, RB-specific defensive per-carry profile only

C_player_defense.method: concatenate A/B feature vectors ONLY if both independently clear development gate

D_explosive.method: player probability <10,10-19,20+ shrink50; conditional carry means shrink20; probability-weighted routine plus two tail contributions; ridge residual from these interpretable quantities

E_states.method: partition <=0,1-9,>=10 and shrink probabilities50/conditional means20; separate success-rate covariate; ridge residual

F_location.method: prior current-team offensive left/middle/right/unknown mixture shrink50 toward league; player contextual yields shrink20 toward player prior; defense contextual yields shrink160 toward league; sum mixture * (player yield + .30*(defense yield - league contextual yield)); ridge residual

G_context.method: prior current-team player context mixture shrink50 toward team then league; disjoint goal-line <=5,short-yard ydstogo<=2, early down1/2, other crossed shotgun/under-center. Context player/defense yields as F; no-huddle prior rate as feature. No realized target mix in prediction.

bootstrap.method: calendar two-week moving blocks of complete games, paired losses, 2000 replicates, seed6412024; retain all player rows per game; percentile95 interval; not row-wise
bootstrap.statistic: candidate minus incumbent mean absolute oracle-carry error; resample game-date-ordered 14-calendar-day blocks

chronology.confirmation: 2025 selection-free for Phase1K; previously exposed by older phases, NOT globally fresh
chronology.refit: selected ridge on all 2024 after development lock, before confirmation

commit_order: source audit + protocol before any fitting/performance

comparators.human: exact frozen competent-human efficiency formula .70 player +.20 defense +.10 position, cutoff-filtered histories
comparators.phase1f_incumbent: Exact frozen Phase1B efficiency function/config used by Phase1F; invoked on cutoff-filtered official stats, never reselected. Phase1E uses same efficiency; full E unavailable until independent gate.
comparators.position_league: last256 legal RB PBP team-games prior, position if >=30 carries otherwise RB league
comparators.recent_player_ypc: ratio of yards/carries last5 legal player stat games, across teams

confirmation_gate: same practical YPC/oracle/bootstrap/catastrophic criteria vs incumbent AND oracle MAE below strongest other fixed comparator; component gate retained; no slice with n>=40 oracle MAE worsening >10%; 2026 oracle/YPC must not worsen >5% or miss40/50 >3pp vs incumbent. Burned2026 never rescues2025 failure.
cutoff: Strict earlier season/week AND historical source game-date +48h <= target game-date -24h (00:00 UTC conservative T24 bound). Same-week games excluded even if completed; historical PBP revisions have no original vintage certification. No target-game situation, run direction, result, roster/health or QB selection as feature.

development_gate.component_gate: A/B/C claim YPC/oracle efficiency only. D/E must additionally improve corresponding 10+/20+ average rate MAE >=1% vs raw recent5 PBP player rate; F/G predicted mixture MAE must improve >=1% vs league mixture. No assertion of causal effect from correlates.

fitting.learner: standardized ridge residual to frozen incumbent; intercept unpenalized
fitting.loss: unweighted squared player-game YPC residual, positive carries only; actual carry count never input
fitting.penalty: n_fit * alpha; train-only mean/std; constant std replaced1
fitting.selection: minimum oracle-carry MAE on later2024; ties YPC MAE, alpha ascending, family lexicographic. Locked before2025. No extra hyperparameters/learners/combinations. No in-season coefficient refitting.

full_projection_gate: Only confirmed efficiency pass allows unchanged Phase1D/E predicted carries and full E comparator. Inherited weekly-roster timing assumptions must remain disclosed; no new roster/OL proxy. Carry MAE and YPC MAE alongside full yards; no cancellation promotion.
metrics: negative/success/10+/20+ player-game rate MAE and predicted vs observed means
oracle_diagnostics: POSTGAME_ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY: after locked pregame efficiency evaluation, actual context/location mixture with unchanged prior contextual yields; actual tail counts with unchanged prior conditional yields. No training/selection/promotion; development diagnostics only if gate fails. Workload oracle is primary; full workload errors not calculated unless independent confirmation passes.
population: For each REG game/team, prior-known RB/FB/HB IDs with at least two prior completed current-team stat games; last three current-team carries average >=5. Stable identity skill may follow teams. Current-team role/mix cannot cross teams. Candidate membership never uses target-game participation. Missing official stat row => realized zero only after whole-game/team source coverage check. Zero-carry candidates retained, excluded only from mathematically undefined YPC/rate metrics. All models use identical receipt keys; no candidate-specific filtering.
source_gate: No fitting until source audit committed. Required numeric fields <=5% missing; run_location left/middle/right/unknown. run_gap blocked; designed QB intent blocked. QB scrambles/kneels/non-RB carries excluded from all candidate PBP aggregates.
sources: frozen official weekly stats: identity/position and rushing/team counters only
stop_rule: If no family passes 2024 development gate, freeze phase immediately. Do not read/score 2025/2026 model performance, do not fit combinations/refit, full projection NOT_RUN. Results report confirmation/diagnostics NOT_RUN_DEVELOPMENT_GATE_FAILED. CI reproduces this conditional stop.
target: RB/FB/HB per-carry rushing efficiency; actual carries x pregame YPC before workload integration
